scripts.build:binary: bun run --filter @webfrost/sdk build && bun run --filter @webfrost/ui build && bun packages/cli/scripts/build-binary.ts
scripts.bench: bun run --filter '*' benchmarks && bun bench/page-load.ts && bun bench/fetch-cache.bench.ts && bun bench/playwright-navigation.bench.ts && bun bench/cli-add.bench.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @webfrost/ui typecheck && bun run --filter @webfrost/docs typecheck
